about_the_game:
Explore an 80's mall inhabited by ravenous beasts, ghosts and all manner of eldritch beings. With proximity voice chat, physics based movement and up to 5 other friends, complete your shift as a member of the Night Crew!

You are hunted. Run or hide from creatures that track with you not only with sight, but sound and smell too.

As a member of the Night Crew, you and a bunch of other misfits are given the mundane task of completing tasks around a mall. Fix cabling, clean up trash, exorcise spirits. And If you or one of your companions meets an unfortunate end... well... someone will have to clean that mess up!

Pick your unique character, each with powerful and upgradable traits that allow you to make a huge impact. Each misfit plays differently, and different combinations will give you endless ways to complete your tasks!

Features

We’ve already implemented a large amount of content!

  • 10 unique enemies

  • 6 iconic crew members

  • 50+ upgrades

  • 20+ tasks

  • A good boy 🐶 

We’re adding a tonne more content, remember to join our Discord for the latest news!

content_descriptors.notes: Night Crew is a low-fidelity horror game. It contains cartoonish but frequent displays of blood and gore, as well as psychological elements.
